title: No Paradise
description: A woman in a black bodysuit with large orange butterfly wings and a pink flower crown stands dramatically on a swirling path, one arm raised as green ethereal smoke flows from her hand. The surreal landscape features melting clocks, floating eyeballs, pink jellyfish, broken stone ruins, and vibrant swirling patterns in the sky.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a woman in a sleek black bodysuit with large translucent orange butterfly wings and a crown of pink flowers, standing on a winding path that reads 'NO PARADISE'. She reaches upward as green ethereal smoke swirls from her hand. The background contains melting clocks, floating eyeballs with wings, pink jellyfish, broken classical ruins, and a vibrant swirling sky in orange, pink, and green tones.
